item.title: Spark: Raytraced Reflections
item.description:
On the left side we have a standard IBL PBR, in this case using the actual environment from my atmospheric scattering implementation, but it could also be using any HDRI cubemap. On the right, we have the next stepping stone, local reflections. Should be an easy improvement to implement… right? Yeah… no…

So what are reflections? Link to heading

item.title: Spark: Atmospheric Scattering
item.description: Last weekend I decided to spend some time implementing an Atmospheric Scattering component in Spark, based on “A Scalable and Production Ready Sky and Atmosphere Rendering Technique” by Sébastien Hillaire (https://sebh.github.io/publications/egsr2020.pdf).
